scope: Source-supported acceptance as a research design; OWS authority, key custody, budgets, operation/effect decoding and proposed bridge scope independently reviewed. No implementation/theorem claim. x402 details remain subject to the separate x402 reviewer.

verified_points.point: Owner bypass and token-plus-file secret recovery are explicit documented design boundaries, so a solver-facing adapter needs a separate actual enforcement boundary.
Current OWS has no Midnight profile or defined MPC/TEE/PCD bridge. Proposed OWS-compatible bridge wording is appropriately qualified.
Only Cardano fills effects; current cumulative spend is zero placeholder. Concurrent reservations require authenticated state outside that context.
Exact signing operation and semantic payload binding are required; allowed chains and typed-data contract rules alone do not prove an economic cap.
Partial outcomes must include failure collateral and residual duties; ordinary signing/broadcast/audit outcomes are weaker evidence.

nonblocking_refinements: At adapter formalization distinguish absent required data, unsupported decoder, known-empty effects and unresolved external evidence. The current fail-closed statement has the right scope.

A budget reservation must be atomic or otherwise serialized in authenticated shared state across federation replicas; a local reservation per replica is insufficient. This is a concrete refinement of the already stated concurrent-budget objective.

A signing-time expiry or deletion-based credential revocation does not automatically revoke an issued signature, a retained key copy or an in-flight external effect; bind lifecycle semantics to the signed policy.
Exact-byte interpretation includes every operation alternative such as signHash/signAuthorization; a proof over one route cannot authorize a different raw signing request.

An isolated or threshold signer still needs statement binding, version/epoch policy, availability and compromise assumptions; compatibility with OWS API conventions does not imply its local storage custody model is mandatory.
evidence_that_would_change_vote: Claiming current OWS provides Midnight, MPC, attested TEE or formal-intention guarantees without a new independently evidenced implementation/profile.
Treating the empty effects array or daily_total zero as a proved absence of value movement or previous spending.
Allowing a solver to recover the underlying unrestricted external key while claiming policy remains cryptographically non-bypassable.
Treating a signature, audit record, attestation, broadcast hash or payment response as sufficient proof of final service delivery.
